retry_after.description: Contract 1.1: seconds before retrying; repeats the Retry-After header of every 429.

state.description: Current driver state (idle, waiting, exposing, reading, download, error). Clients preserve unknown additive values; future discovery lifecycle is separate.

alpaca.description: Null unless the Alpaca listener is bound on this request ingress.

boot_id.description: Contract 1.2: boot domain of next_cursor; send it back as the boot_id query parameter. Absent from earlier servers.

role.description: Declared purpose: control, preview, imaging, rest, stream or other. Treat unknown values as other.

protocol.description: Declared application protocol carried by this port.

reserve_seconds.description: Night reservation horizon in seconds (at most 14 hours), counted by the bridge clock.

reservation_expires_in.description: Present on a night reservation: its true remaining seconds. expires_in stays capped at 3600.

reserve_seconds.description: Night reservation horizon in seconds (at most 14 hours), counted by the bridge clock.

link.description: unreachable (contract 1.2): a station instrument that does not answer on the bridge network; treat unknown values as saved.

protocol.description: Protocol family to choose a driver from; null when the family declares none. Treat unknown values as unsupported.

model.description: Instrument model when known (verified identity or attached camera driver), otherwise null. Never the owner-chosen name.

hardware_id.description: Installation-local keyed digest of a manufacturer-reported identifier; never the identifier itself.

verified_identity.description: Identity read during this service run by a read-only manufacturer reply on the current link; null when unverified.

identity_source.description: Which read-only reply verified the identity; unverified when none applies to the current link.

access.description: direct = the bridge joins the instrument Wi-Fi with a radio; station (contract 1.2) = the instrument joined the bridge network (hotspot or private LAN) and uses no radio; attached = USB camera.

current_operation.description: Contract 1.2: read-only operation evidence used by protect_running_operations; null when the instrument reports none. kind is set only while running; since is the bridge UTC time this state was first observed.

simultaneous.description: Contract 1.1: true when it is connected or connecting it needs no replacement (a free radio exists). False means connecting it disconnects another instrument; adding a Wi-Fi adapter avoids that.

progress.description: Contract 1.1 switch progress: a countdown estimate from typical phase budgets, bounded by the operation deadline; null eta after failure.

target_port.description: Instrument port this client port relays to.

alternatives.description: One entry per management path for the first relayed port.

services.description: Multi-port isolated instruments (Vespera 8082 HTTP and 8083 Socket.IO): every relayed port on every management path.

link.description: unreachable (contract 1.2): a station instrument that does not answer on the bridge network; treat unknown values as saved.

timestamp.description: Best-effort device time; use sequence for ordering.

radio_id.description: Opaque identifier for this service run, never a MAC address.

interfaces.description: Management roles only; present on announcement_updated.

utc_corrected.description: Optional estimate; sequence remains the ordering authority.

access_token.description: Opaque, expires after 12 hours or a service restart.

management_endpoints.description: Contract 1.2: the bridge web interface on each confirmed management path; empty when unknown. Open url as given; never build it.

contract_minor.description: Minor version of contract 1 (1 since 1.1, 2 since 1.2).

free_radios.description: Instrument-capable radios currently unused: a connect needing a radio will not replace anything while this is above zero.

tls_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the bridge CA certificate while local HTTPS is ready; a trust-on-first-use pin, verified again over TLS.
